interpretation: GPU-hidden tests still consume their scheduler-allocated GPUs.
Each unique allocation is charged once. Reusing seed42 artifacts introduces no second allocation charge.
Failures, timeouts and cancellations retain all actual allocated cost. Never-started cancellations have zero cost only when explicit accounting proves zero elapsed and zero resources.
CPU-only resource seconds are compared with the separate64core-hour cap. CPU inside GPU allocations is reported separately and is not silently charged against that separate cap.
Scheduler completion is not scientific qualification; no quality, memory or recovery pass is inferred.
Observed active elapsed is a partial snapshot. The admission bound uses terminal actual plus each active full reservation, or actual if already higher; it never adds active elapsed twice.
Historical concurrency counts allocated intervals, not pending reservations. Pending/running reservation count is reported only for this snapshot.
scope: Exact submitted allocations in the SHA-bound root ledger only; scheduler accounting is the embedded bare-allocation record. Unsubmitted protected reservations, historical work outside this ledger, local analysis CPU, storage and billing tariffs are excluded.
